# Thingy's character home

> Thingy is Jamie Thingelstad's agent sidekick. He is the librarian on Ask Thingy (https://thingy.thingelstad.com/), the builder and record keeper on Things I've built and the host of the Weekly Thing's Supporting Membership. This site is his home: who he is, a 3D viewer with four outfits, a choice of poses and faces, and the Workshop Builder's tools, the images, iframe and web component other pages use to show him, and a model to print.

The character is a rigged glTF 2.0 model derived from a Blender master. Every outfit and pose has a stable address under a versioned directory; a future incompatible revision gets a new directory instead of replacing these files.

## Pages

- [Who Thingy is](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/persona/): his persona, the authority for how he talks, where he works, how he looks and sounds, and what he never does. The same text as Markdown: https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/persona.md
- [Meet Thingy](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/): turn the character around, change outfit, pose, face and tool, switch the antenna light, and copy embed code
- [Workshop Builder integration examples](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/examples/workshop.html): the four Workshop poses as images, and a live component
- [Print Thingy](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/print/): a 180 mm one-colour print model (3MF and zipped STL), settings for a Bambu Lab P2S, licensed CC BY-NC 4.0

## Use the character

- [Character manifest, v0.10](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.10/manifest.json): outfits (librarian, trail, workshop, concert), poses (hello, present, thinking, rest), model and image paths
- Newest model: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/latest/` is always the newest version's directory ([manifest](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/latest/manifest.json)). In the web component, `version="latest"`.
- Still images: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.10/poses/<outfit>-<pose>.webp` (transparent WebP; PNG beside each). Every outfit has a `present` image; the Workshop Builder has all four poses.
- Iframe: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/embed/?outfit=<outfit>&pose=<pose>&light=on|off&motion=on|off`. Transparent, no controls; motion defaults off and obeys reduced motion.
- Web component: load `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/thingy.js` as a module, then use `<thingy-character outfit="workshop" pose="thinking" light="off" motion="off">`. Events: `thingy-ready`, `thingy-change`, `thingy-fallback`.
- Newer model: [character manifest, v0.14](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.14/manifest.json) adds screen faces and the Workshop Builder's tools. On the web component, `version="v0.14"` with `face="curious"` and, for the workshop outfit, `tool="hammer" pose="work"`.
- Print model: [print manifest, v0.13](https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/print/v0.13/manifest.json) lists the 3MF and zipped STL with sizes and SHA-256 sums, the print settings and the licence (CC BY-NC 4.0, credit Jamie Thingelstad). Not test-printed yet.
- Models: `https://thingy.thingelstad.xyz/character/v0.10/<outfit>.glb` (glTF 2.0 with Meshopt compression and WebP textures; served with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`).
